caption: The drawing features a stylized eagle with its wings fully spread out horizontally, occupying the central portion of the image. The eagle is rendered in shades of light brown and tan, with detailed feather patterns visible on its wings and body. Its head is tilted downward, with the beak open, and the eyes are accentuated. Behind the eagle’s head is a semicircular radiant halo of golden yellow lines. The eagle is perched atop an ornate decorative base consisting of scrolling, baroque-style elements in brown and gold with a dark green background. The overall composition is centered on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or patterns. In the lower right quadrant near the ornament, the name “S. Jerome Haas” is inscribed in small, orange-brown letters.
title: Stern Decoration
